releaseNotes: Codex now receives one automatic paste when dictation ends, without Command-Return, when the same window remains active and no input or focus changes were observed.
The Codex compatibility path keeps the final text on the clipboard and does not live-edit or learn from an unreadable field. Other apps retain their field-pinning rules.
Free, uncapped, locally signed and unnotarized beta. Codex paste receipt remains unverified through Accessibility.
